tasks.short: Set labelling standards and approve meat or poultry labels.

steps.what: Retrieve actual applicable meat and poultry labelling requirements and product evidence
Set labeling standards for the actual meat or poultry product
Enter and check chosen standards in the inspection management system {OTHER}
Save the checked final labelling standard record
Inspect the final label against actual product evidence and chosen standards
Approve labels only after the actual final label and conformity findings exist
outputs: checked final label approval decision and exact label version

steps.what: Commit the checked final label approval decision
inputs: checked final label approval decision and exact label version

tasks.design: Configure current source links in {DOCS} and native standard fields in the inspection management system {OTHER}. The inspector sets standards, checks the actual final label and makes the approval decision; each record commit follows its existing final check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Standards work can repeat source lookup and reference-field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned source links and native product references can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, product claims and approval require actual inspection authority and evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector recognises when an apparently complete label misrepresents the actual product.
tasks.altitude: Less lookup and standard-record entry; label decision rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned source links and structured inspection records can reduce lookup and entry; they do not establish label compliance or approval authority.

assumptions: Actual authoritative source owner provides current requirements; producer provides actual product specification and exact final label. Inspector verifies applicability in s1/s2; missing evidence remains manual.

Standard setting and label approval may occur at different frequencies. Shares describe a provisional combined task mix, not a mandatory full standard rewrite per label or a measured baseline; reweight actual branches.

Only actual duplicate references are eligible. Test native source views and fields first; existing configuration earns no saving. External notification, if required, is a separate gated send with no saving claimed here.
Routine commits retain one percent each. Their gates use existing checks; no extra self-approval ceremony is added.
unknowns: What authority does this inspector actually hold?
Which source and product references are entered twice?
research_questions: Can native source links reduce preparation while preserving exact final-label verification?

incremental.description: Maintain current requirement links and inspection field defaults.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final labelling standard record and exact product destination; edits require recheck
s6 checked final approval decision for the exact final label version and product record; any label edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 lookup + 14*0.20 entry = 10.8; minus 1 upkeep = 9.8. Half eligible gives 5.4 minus 1 = 4.4. Standards choice, label inspection, approval and commits remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise growers on quality-production programmes, equipment and techniques.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual development programs, new equipment and techniques for quality production
inputs: actual current programme and technical information
actual grower question and production context
outputs: checked relevant programme and technical sources

steps.what: Advise farmers or growers using actual production needs and relevant sources
inputs: checked relevant programme and technical sources

steps.what: Enter and check actual advice in the existing inspection management record {OTHER}
inputs: checked relevant programme and technical sources

steps.what: Save the checked final grower advice record

tasks.design: Configure source lookup in {DOCS} and existing grower/reference defaults in the inspection management system {OTHER}. The inspector checks relevance, personally advises the grower and captures only the advice actually given.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice work can repeat programme lookup and grower-reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views and record defaults can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Local production conditions and appropriate recommendations need inspector judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector explains trade-offs and hears constraints that are absent from a catalogue.
tasks.altitude: Less advice preparation and reference entry; recommendations stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured programme lookup and existing advice-record defaults can reduce preparation and entry; they do not choose suitable production techniques.

assumptions: Actual programme and equipment information must exist and be current; inspector verifies relevance in s1. Grower context is captured in retained s2, and actual advice is entered and checked in s3; no free transcript is assumed.
Only an existing advice record is included. If none exists, omit s3/s4 and reweight; no new reporting baseline is invented. Record cuts cover repeated references, not capture of conversation meaning.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native views/defaults first; already configured work earns no saving. Routine save stays one percent and uses the existing final record check.
unknowns: Which programme sources are currently consulted?
Is advice actually recorded by this inspector?
research_questions: Can source and record defaults reduce effort without adding administration?

incremental.description: Keep actual programme links and grower-reference defaults current.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual advice record and exact grower destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup + 14*0.20 reference entry = 8.8; minus 0.8 upkeep = 8. Half eligible gives 4.4 minus 0.8 = 3.6. Advice, meaning capture and routine save remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual inspection evidence needed for legal testimony
outputs: checked relevant source evidence for testimony

steps.what: Testify in legal proceedings from actual knowledge and checked source evidence
inputs: checked relevant source evidence for testimony

tasks.design: Configure native case/exhibit source links in {DOCS} and the inspection management system {OTHER} for actual evidence retrieval. The inspector checks originals and gives testimony personally, including uncertainty and limits of recollection.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence preparation can require repeated navigation through actual inspection records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case and exhibit indexing can shorten retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Truthful recollection, questioning and evidential interpretation remain personal responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector distinguishes firsthand observations from records and inference.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation; testimony remains entirely human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case links can support evidence retrieval; generated testimony cannot replace a witness's actual knowledge.

assumptions: Actual inspection records and exhibit identifiers already exist; inspector locates and verifies relevant originals in s1. No new document digitisation, generated recollection or free preparation is assumed.

Boundary is source preparation and actual oral testimony. No separate witness statement, record write, report or digital send is required by the stated task; actual additional duties must be decomposed separately before estimating savings.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Only repeated source navigation is eligible; existing indexed access earns zero saving. Reading and understanding source evidence remain retained.
unknowns: How much actual preparation is source navigation?
research_questions: Do native links reduce retrieval without encouraging reliance on summaries?

incremental.description: Maintain source links for actual case records.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 retrieval = 10; minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5. All actual testimony and evidential judgement remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Inspectors keep standards, product conformity, advice and testimony judgement while actual lookup and record duplication may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual repeated work before changing inspection records, preserving final-label approval and truthful testimony.
